This document outlines the 
equipment inspection I1 for unit 5, which must be performed every six months as 
indicated by M6 in the title block.

The 
first draft is initiated by eng. Emad Mohamed El-Tohamy, tested by eng. Sawsan 
Elsaid Ali, reviewed 
by eng. Mohamed Mohamed Baranya, accepted 
by eng. Mohamed Mahmoud Kowela general manager, approved by eng Aly El-Fayoumy, 
and certified by eng. Mona Ahmed Al Sherqawy: WDEPC consultant engineer "A" and 
MPIS Coordinator.
A work permit must be issued.

The qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable ID 
 safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety helmet, safety shoes ... etc

The following mechanical consignment to be done:
 * Close the suction valve for pump "UV 101"
 * Close the discharge valves no. "UV 102, UV 103"
 * Close the heating valves no. "HV 111, HV 112"
 * Close the valves no. "HV 117, HV118, HV119"
 * Open the valve no. "HV 116, HV122, HV1123"
 * Close the valve no. "HV102"
 * Open the valve no. "HV107"
 * Open the ventilation valve no "HV 109" until 
 the pressure escaping.
 * Open the ventilation valve no "HV 109" to protect the 
 motor and monitoring the body temperature 
 * Close the valve no "HV 120"
 * Open the valve no "HV 121, HU 106"
 * Open the valves no "HU 114, HV 113"

The following electrical consignment to be done:
 * Disconnect the 6kv circuit breaker of the pump motor, rack it 
 out and lock it.
 * Connect temporary earthing on the motor circuit breaker.
 * Disconnect the circuit breaker of the suction valve ref. UV 101 
 and rack it out and lock it

 cooling circuit valves

 circuit to remove any precipitates or partial blocking in the lines

General cleaning to 
 the cooling water pipes and paint it if required

Check the pump body 
 thermal insulation
